About us: Come on into an iconic former bank building where offices and ATMs have made way for a brand-new hotel. First impression? 204 elegantly furnished rooms, 7 floors and a warm welcome from your future team. Inside voco The Hague you will find restaurant Botanica and cocktailbar Ultramarijn. Your day to day: 
• Handling incoming Groups & Events requests in a timely manner and being the main point of contact   
• Preparing tailor-made offers, contracts and Proforma invoices for all our Groups & Events.    
• Perform Site inspections and engage our clients in the voco® The Hague storytelling  
• Optimize Groups & Events revenues and increase guest satisfaction  
• Work closely with all Operational teams to ensure a smooth execution of all Groups & Events  
• Living the voco™ brand with pride, passion & energy. Creating & inspiring others to deliver memorable branded guest experiences. 
• Promoting teamwork and lifestyle service through daily communication and coordination with other teams.  
• Ad-hoc duties as required – unexpected moments when we have to pull together as a team to get a task done.  
• Bring your own project – You'll also get to work on a school-related project that adds value and helps you grow.

• Passion for hospitality 
• An amazing sense of creativity.

• Pro-active attitude and eye for detail with a natural drive for continuous improvement.

Do you carry trays full of cocktails more balanced than a gymnastic on the balance beam? We're on the lookout for hospitable servers for Stadscafe. Apply now!

As a Service Employee, you are at the very heart of our restaurant. You work across breakfast, lunch, and dinner service, serving dishes, creating a warm atmosphere, and ensuring guests have an unforgettable experience — often before they even ask. No two days are the same, as you effortlessly switch between different moments of the day in a dynamic and lively environment.

You're an all-rounder: you work according to established procedures, while keeping your approach personal and genuinely hospitable. At the same time, you make sure every table experience is spot on — from start to finish. You introduce guests to high-quality products and fine wines, and have a natural feel for what each guest needs.

Stadscafe stands for good food, great drinks and a pure and genuine atmosphere. A place for anything from early birds with their newspaper and coffee in the morning, to the lovebirds on a datenight with a cocktail at the bar. Our restaurant is located in the heart of Westerpark, in a historic building right next to the Conscious Hotel Westerpark. Whether hotel guests come in for breakfast, locals drop by for drinks, or someone is looking for a relaxed moment, you make sure they feel immediately welcome and at home.

About you:

• 
You are looking for a fun part-time job and are flexible, including weekends;

• 
Strong focus on communication and hospitality;

• 
Enjoys working in a dynamic hospitality environment;

• 
At least 1 year of experience in a similar role;

• 
Fluent in Dutch and English;

• 
A true love for good food.

 - 
Writing your thesis at EY. You choose your own topic and receive guidance from experienced professionals from the audit practice. 
 - 
While writing your thesis, you receive support at EY with collecting your data and can draw on our expertise. 
 - 
You are given room for personal and professional development, as you have the opportunity to shadow at various clients. 
 - 
You start together with an enthusiastic group of fellow script writers and you also get to know many EY colleagues. 
 - 
After completing your thesis, it is possible to transition into an entry-level position and continue studying towards your RA title.
